data.description: 冬夜屋内，她捧着热茶与草莓大福，脸颊被热气熏得微红；听到关于某人的话题时突然呛到、满脸通红地解释，满屋都是藏不住的心意。
data.promptProse: Mitsuri Kanroji holds warm tea beside strawberry daifuku in the winter room, suddenly coughing in surprise when a familiar person's name is mentioned. She blushes and tries to explain, pink-green braids swaying above her cream blouse and pink apron. The medium view includes the serving table and quiet room wall. Lamplight warms her cheeks and cup steam, with soft dish shadows and darker folds around the green skirt.
